# Long Island Homes

> Town by town real estate guides for sellers and buyers on the South Shore of Long Island (Nassau County), written by Bisendra Melaram, Team Leader of Keller Williams Greater Nassau in Garden City, NY, and a seller's agent on Long Island's South Shore. Licensed Real Estate Salesperson since 2003. Each page cites public sources and carries a last-updated date.

Author: [Bisendra Melaram](https://bisendramelaram.com/). Office: Keller Williams Greater Nassau, 400 Garden City Plaza, Suite 438, Garden City, NY 11530. Phone 516-873-7100.

## Town guides
- [Valley Stream, NY real estate guide](https://longislandhomes.co/towns/valley-stream/): Valley Stream is an incorporated village in the Town of Hempstead on the Queens border, with 40,634 residents in 2020. It has two LIRR stations, Valley Stream and Gibson, on the Far Rockaway and Long Beach branches. Elementary schools come from three districts, 13, 24 and 30, and high school from Valley Stream Central.
- [Lynbrook, NY real estate guide](https://longislandhomes.co/towns/lynbrook/): Lynbrook is an incorporated village of about two square miles in the Town of Hempstead, with 20,438 residents in 2020. Lynbrook station, on Sunrise Highway, is served by Long Beach Branch trains and some Babylon Branch trains. Five school districts serve parts of the village, so the district depends on the exact address.
- [Rockville Centre, NY real estate guide](https://longislandhomes.co/towns/rockville-centre/): Rockville Centre is an incorporated village in the Town of Hempstead, with 26,016 residents in 2020. Its LIRR station is on the Babylon Branch. Most homes are in the Rockville Centre school district, but about a fifth of residents are in the Oceanside district and some are in Baldwin's. The village runs its own electric utility.
- [Oceanside, NY real estate guide](https://longislandhomes.co/towns/oceanside/): Oceanside is an unincorporated hamlet in the Town of Hempstead, with 32,637 residents in 2020 and its own school district. Its LIRR station is on the Long Beach Branch. Hurricane Sandy flooded the southern part of Oceanside in 2012, so the flood zone and the cost of flood insurance belong at the top of any buyer's checklist.
- [Baldwin, NY real estate guide](https://longislandhomes.co/towns/baldwin/): Baldwin is an unincorporated hamlet in the Town of Hempstead, with 33,919 residents in 2020. Its LIRR station is on the Babylon Branch. Most of Baldwin is in the Baldwin school district, with small parts in the Oceanside, Rockville Centre, Roosevelt and Uniondale districts. The hamlet sits between Milburn Creek and Parsonage Creek.
- [Freeport, NY real estate guide](https://longislandhomes.co/towns/freeport/): Freeport is an incorporated village in the Town of Hempstead and, with 44,472 people in 2020, the largest of these six towns. Its LIRR station is on the Babylon Branch. Freeport Public Schools serves the village, Freeport runs its own electric utility, and the Nautical Mile on Woodcleft Canal is its waterfront.
